mount.__note: CORE-ONLY MOUNT. astryx.json wraps stages in <Theme theme={neutralTheme}> because that is the library's README quick start. That is a legitimate mount, but it is NOT the surface recipe/fixtures/library-*.ts transcribe: those carry @astryxdesign/core dist/astryx.css :root defaults (#0064E0 accent, -apple-system body stack, --radius-inner 4px, --radius-element 8px), which theme-neutral overrides to #262626 / Figtree / 6px / 10px. Capturing only the themed mount left every Astryx subject 0% mechanically verified and forced 56 of the reader's 57 drifts into one blanket excuse. This config captures the un-themed core surface so the fixtures can be checked against the thing they actually describe. Keep BOTH: they are two real mounts of the same library, not a right one and a wrong one. FONT: the wrapper carries font-family: var(--font-family-body) explicitly. In the themed mount the Theme provider's own wrapper div applies the base font (stylex class x9ynric); with no provider nothing does, and text inheriting from an unstyled body falls back to Times — the FC-FONT-SUBSTRATE defect, which showed up here as alert/astryx and chip/astryx drifting -apple-system -> Times. The var is core's OWN declaration in dist/astryx.css (--font-family-body: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, ...); applying it is reproducing core's stated body font, not inventing one. Elements that set font-family themselves (FieldLabel) were unaffected either way.

fonts.__note: FC-FONT-SUBSTRATE closure. NOT A GUESS: @astryxdesign/theme-neutral declares 'Figtree, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, ...' as --font-family-body/--font-family-heading (dist/theme.css:149-150, dist/neutral.js:83-84) — the library's OWN first-choice face; weights 400/500/600/700 are the library's full --font-weight-normal/medium/semibold/bold token set (core dist/astryx.css). Files committed under extract/computed/fonts/figtree/ from @fontsource/figtree@5.3.0 (exact-pinned in examples/astryx/.astryx-sandbox/package.json). Inlined as data: URIs — no network at render or check time. NOTE: the face only renders because the mount fix above makes --font-family-body resolve to Figtree at capture — loading a face for a token that never resolves was the trap this round refused.

components.name: Button
components.__note:sampleText: SAMPLE TEXT = THE CONTRACT'S OWN DEFAULT. It was "Save changes", which the seed contract never declares — the seed's `label` default is "Button" (examples/astryx/contracts-seed/button.contract.json), and "Button" is therefore the string the emitted Figma set paints into every cell. So the developed reference read "Save chan…" (truncated at the lg cell width) while the canvas read "Button": every canvas-vs-developed pixel comparison for this stem was measuring an arbitrary harness string against the contract default, on top of whatever real defect existed. Any other astryx component's sampleText already equals its contract text default (Badge "New", Card "Card content", Slider "Volume", Switch "Enable notifications") — Button was the one that did not.

components.name: Badge
components.__note:labelIsAProp: THE SAMPLE TEXT NEVER REACHED THE COMPONENT. `sampleText` mounts as CHILDREN, and `@astryxdesign/core@0.1.6` Badge takes a REQUIRED `label: ReactNode` prop and renders NOTHING from children (dist/Badge/Badge.d.ts:61 + its own @example `<Badge label="Active" />`). So every committed Badge capture was of an EMPTY badge: the real-library render at Variant=Blue is a 16x20 label-less pill, against a 42x20 canvas cell reading "New" — a 2.63x content-box ratio that read as FC-REF-FRAMING and was really a mount defect. React tolerated the ignored child silently, and nothing downstream could tell an empty badge from a full one because BOTH sides of the fidelity gate mounted the same way. `label` now mounts as a fixed prop with the string the canvas paints; the contract keeps `children` as the materialized text slot bound to the Figma TEXT property (Astryx types the label as a ReactNode, which extraction drops as a `node` prop — see DEV-JOURNEY.md), so the contract vocabulary is unchanged.

components.name: Switch
components.__note:valueAxis: Wave B.3 FC-MISSING-AXIS — value IS a variant axis on the contract side (seed + committed switch.contract.json v0.2.0 carry it as a VARIANT-bound boolean; thumb geometry from Switch.tsx source constants, not harness-captured). It is NOT listed in `axes`: capture's propSpaceFor enumerates enum props only (booleans ride stateProps — §1.4), the claimed 'prop adapter / sample casting in capture' was never built, and the committed captured truth (33a1ded2) carries no value dimension — so listing it made every offline re-fuse (ua-baseline:check) refuse while capturing nothing. Re-adding it requires a REAL recapture with the MUI Switch spelling: enum seed axis (off/on) + axisValueMap {off:false,on:true}.

components.name: Slider
components.__note:stageWidth: STAGE INNER WIDTH = 240px, the width the contract's own anatomy declares for the track (examples/astryx/contracts/slider.contract.json, `width: 240px`) and the width the emitted Figma set paints as a cell. Slider is a fill-width control; in the default flex stage it shrink-to-fit at 48px, and the resulting 240-vs-48 content-box ratio was carried as FC-ABS-SIZE ("canvas track 240px vs developed ~49px") — a HARNESS container fact receipted as a component defect. Same pin and same reasoning as ProgressBar and TextInput.

components.__note:readmitted: RE-ADMITTED (was `_bannerReceipt`, EXCLUDED for a double-run determinism refusal: height/transform/radii unstable on an unsettled expand/collapse transition). The transition belongs to the collapse TOGGLE, which Banner renders only when it receives `children` (Banner.tsx header comment: "When children are provided, a collapse/expand toggle button appears in the end area"). This mount passes NO children (sampleText ""), so the toggle never exists and there is nothing to settle. If the double-run self-check refuses it again the exclusion stands and is re-recorded — the refusal is the instrument, not an obstacle.

components.__note:stageWidth: STAGE INNER WIDTH = 240px, the width the contract's own anatomy declares for the track (examples/astryx/contracts/progress-bar.contract.json root part `width: 240px`, the Wave B.3 showcase width the emitted Figma set paints as a 240px cell). Pinning the inner width to the contract's declared width makes the comparison measure paint and structure instead of an arbitrary container. blockStage gives width:auto a block formatting context to fill (the MUI Card finding).

_coverageNote: COVERAGE = 10 of the 13 stems the astryx console-loop lane pins. Before this round the config carried FIVE components (Button, Badge, Card, Switch, Slider) and eight lane stems had NO correctly-themed 1x developed reference to score against at all — their committed references were emit-html first-item renders in the pre-Theme Times substrate, a POLARIS Banner (FC-REF-CROSS-LIBRARY), or a 1440x2200 documentation screenshot (FC-REF-WHOLE-PAGE). Banner, CheckboxInput, ProgressBar, TextInput and Token are added here. The three still absent are DropdownMenu, DropdownMenuItem and Toast: they are COMPOSITION-tier contracts (multi-root / repeated-row / slot-bearing), not single-component mounts, so a single-component capture config is the wrong instrument for them and they stay fail-closed by name rather than being handed a guessed reference.
__seedNote: SEEDS ARE FROZEN INPUTS, NEVER PROMOTE OUTPUT. This config pointed at examples/astryx/contracts/ — the directory promote WRITES — so capture read its own previous result and the round-trip was not idempotent. Measured damage in the shipped artifacts: button/badge/slider each carried the FLOOR-PROMOTED and COMPUTED-ENRICHED provenance sentence TWICE, card once, and switch had never promoted at all (still v0.1.0) — five components in three different states. The seeds now live in examples/astryx/contracts-seed/, derived from the Phase-A static extraction. One measured correction rides in them: Button.size carries default "md", which the static adapter dropped and the library's own dist/docs-types.d.ts declares — a defaultless enum AXIS is the case that fails with an unhelpful error (docs/23 §4.7). Pinned by the eval `capture-seeds-are-not-promote-output`.
